Description: 果物のジュースにスパイスを加えたホットドリンク。ノンアルコールで子どもたちに大人気
This blend of fruit juice and spices proves popular with children every Starlight. Its gentle warmth radiates through even a gloved hand.
Contains a proposal intended for the leaders of Yok Tural's new ventures, or so Liplu says.
This boxed meal contains more food than any one person could eat, although the tantalizing aromas wafting from it make the idea hard to resist.
飾り用の小さなパンプキンに幻術をかけて作った煙玉。対象に投げつけると、幻影を見破る効果がある
A portable decorative pumpkin enchanted with glamour-dispelling magicks.
A curious crystal capable of storing the bearer's memories─martial or otherwise.
Severed from the head of the Abductor, this horn is rich in the aether that once connected the creature to the isle's architect.
